#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

pair<int, int> scanWord(char ch[], int n, int start) {
    int count = 0;
    int j = start;
    while (true) {
        if (ch[j] != '_' && ch[j] != '(') {
            count++;
        }
        if (ch[j] == '_' || ch[j] == '(' || j == n - 1) {
            return {j, count};
        }
        j++;
    }
}

int scanInside(char ch[], int n, int start, int& counter) {
    int count = 0;
    int j = start;
    while (true) {
        if (j >= n) {
            return start;
        }
        if ((ch[j] == '_' || ch[j] == ')') && count > 0) {
            counter++;
            count = 0;
        }
        if (ch[j] == ')') {
            return j;
        }
        if (ch[j] != '_' && ch[j] != '(') {
            count++;
        }
        j++;
    }
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int maxLen = 0;
    int countw = 0;
    string x;
    cin >> x;
    char* ch = &x[0];

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        if (ch[i] != '_' && ch[i] != '(') {
            pair<int, int> r = scanWord(ch, n, i);
            maxLen = max(maxLen, r.second);
            i = r.first;
        }
        if (ch[i] == '(') {
            int add = 0;
            i = scanInside(ch, n, i, add);
            countw += add;
        }
        i++;
    }

    cout << maxLen << " " << countw << endl;
    return 0;
}
